identitySignals: Name matches a registered nonprofit: 'Change The Tune Inc', EIN 82-2460199, Los Angeles, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), matching the agenda's 'Change The Tune Inc.' and 'Los Angeles, CA'

changethetune.org describes a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building youth-leadership curriculum and project-based learning for students, consistent with OUSD's after-school and summer programs contracts; its donation link is under the name 'change-the-tune-inc'
research.notes: Medium because the organization's own website does not state a city or mention Oakland Unified, so the link between the website and the Los Angeles registry record rests on the name and the 'change-the-tune-inc' donation link. profile.summary: A nonprofit that develops curriculum focused on youth leadership and 21st-century skills. It works with students, educators and community partners through project-based learning, aiming to close the opportunity gap for youth in underserved communities.
